# Oakheart Technologies

> Careful engineering. Efficient processes. Problems solved at the source.

Oakheart Technologies is a software consultancy in Spokane, Washington, serving small and mid-size businesses locally and remotely. It fixes failing software, replaces manual processes with automation, reviews software and cloud costs, and builds custom software and interactive VR training. Engagements usually start with a short, fixed-price assessment.

## Services
- [Workflow Checkup](https://oakhearttech.com/services/workflow-checkup/): the fixed-price first step for every project, with the focus you choose (a workflow, software costs, where AI fits, or reporting), ending in a written, ranked action plan
- [Software Rescue](https://oakhearttech.com/services/software-rescue/): assessing and repairing stalled, broken or AI-built software and websites
- [Automation and Integrations](https://oakhearttech.com/services/automation-integrations/): connecting existing tools so data isn't re-typed
- [Software and Subscription Cost Review](https://oakhearttech.com/services/software-cost-review/): finding overlapping, unused and oversized subscriptions
- [Practical AI Implementation](https://oakhearttech.com/services/ai-implementation/): finding where AI helps, then building checked workflows for lead intake, follow-up and customer updates, with plain scripts where exact results matter
- [Dashboards and Reporting](https://oakhearttech.com/services/dashboards-reporting/): the numbers a business needs, pulled from accounting, CRM and job tracking onto one screen that stays current
- [Custom Software and Websites](https://oakhearttech.com/services/custom-software/)
- [Interactive and VR Training](https://oakhearttech.com/services/interactive-vr/)
